choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.games WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_id = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.characters WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND character_key = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.attributes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND attribute_key = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.equipment WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND equipment_key = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.skills WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND skill_key = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.statuses WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND status_key = #{sourceKey} AND #{sourceParentKey} = ''

mapper.select: SELECT image_key, name, enabled FROM public.images WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND image_key = #{imageKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.image_relations (game_id, source_type, source_parent_key, source_key, image_key) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceParentKey}, #{sourceKey}, #{imageKey}) ON CONFLICT (game_id, source_type, source_parent_key, source_key) DO UPDATE SET image_key = EXCLUDED.image_key
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.image_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND ((source_type = 'SKILL' AND source_parent_key = '' AND source_key = #{skillKey}) OR (source_type = 'SKILL_EFFECT' AND source_parent_key = #{skillKey}))
mapper.select: SELECT image_key, name FROM public.images WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND enabled = TRUE AND (strpos(lower(name), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(image_key), lower(#{keyword})) > 0) ORDER BY name, image_key LIMIT 50

SELECT r.source_type, r.source_parent_key, r.source_key, CASE r.source_type WHEN 'GAME' THEN g.game_name WHEN 'CHARACTER' THEN c.name WHEN 'ATTRIBUTE' THEN a.name WHEN 'EQUIPMENT' THEN q.name WHEN 'SKILL' THEN s.name WHEN 'SKILL_EFFECT' THEN e.name WHEN 'STATUS' THEN t.name END AS source_name, CASE r.source_type WHEN 'ATTRIBUTE' THEN a.status WHEN 'SKILL' THEN s.status WHEN 'STATUS' THEN t.status END AS source_status, p.name AS parent_name FROM public.image_relations r LEFT JOIN public.games g ON r.source_type = 'GAME' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND g.game_id = r.game_id AND g.game_id = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.characters c ON r.source_type = 'CHARACTER' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND c.game_id = r.game_id AND c.character_key = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.attributes a ON r.source_type = 'ATTRIBUTE' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND a.game_id = r.game_id AND a.attribute_key = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.equipment q ON r.source_type = 'EQUIPMENT' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND q.game_id = r.game_id AND q.equipment_key = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.skills s ON r.source_type = 'SKILL' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND s.game_id = r.game_id AND s.skill_key = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.skill_effects e ON r.source_type = 'SKILL_EFFECT' AND e.game_id = r.game_id AND e.skill_key = r.source_parent_key AND e.effect_key = r.source_key LEFT JOIN public.skills p ON r.source_type = 'SKILL_EFFECT' AND p.game_id = r.game_id AND p.skill_key = r.source_parent_key LEFT JOIN public.statuses t ON r.source_type = 'STATUS' AND r.source_parent_key = '' AND t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.status_key = r.source_key WHERE r.game_id = #{gameId} AND r.image_key = #{imageKey} ORDER BY source_name, r.source_key, r.source_parent_key, r.source_type
